title: finding(app-shell): PageView spreads `(page as any).context` into the rendered node, but PageSchema refuses `context` — a documented authoring channel no author can use
body:
Ruled: 5811058824 · letter remove (drop the refused context spread) · 2026-09-24T08:57Z

`packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` spreads `(page as any).context` into the node it hands `SchemaRenderer`. **`PageSchema` refuses `context`** — so every page that parses spreads `undefined`, and the key documents author-supplied page context that **no author can supply**.

## How it was found

By the census landed for objectui#9438 (PR #9670), on its **first run over `main`**. ⭐ That card's own text states no live instance remains; the instrument reported **two**, and this is one of them.

The read is written through a **type escape** (`as any`), which is why a checker-driven walk could not see it and a `.pages` grep would miss the seam entirely. The census anchors on the seam — where the value becomes `any` — and looks *through* the cast.

## Why this is class (b)

`PageSchema` is the declared contract for what a page may carry. It **refuses** `context`. The renderer reads it anyway, so:

- for every page that **does** parse, the spread contributes `undefined` — a no-op wearing the shape of a feature;
- the key nonetheless reads, to anyone opening this file, as a supported authoring channel. It is not.

## ⛔ Why it was not repaired in PR #9670

Deliberate, and I endorse it: this is a **renderer behaviour change with its own open question** — *what should happen for metadata that never passed `PageSchema`?* — not a prevention-card repair. objectui#9438 delivered the walk; folding a behaviour decision into it would have mixed an instrument with a judgement.

## What a fix has to decide

- Drop the spread, or make `context` authorable in `PageSchema`? ⚠️ The second **widens a published acceptance set** and is a `Clause-②: yes` change — ⛔ not a thing to do casually to make a read legal.
- What the answer is for metadata that never passed `PageSchema` at all: today the cast makes that case indistinguishable from the parsing one.
